Tells the agent to `npm install` three official @azure packages (SKILL.md:19-25) and configure an Application Insights connection string and DefaultAzureCredential for log ingestion (SKILL.md:31, 218); the instrumented app sends telemetry to the user's Azure Monitor resource. The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for the package installs and live-credential/telemetry configuration; acceptable because packages are official Azure SDK packages and telemetry goes to the user's own resource as part of their task.

Auto-instrumentation can export request data (HTTP, database calls) to Application Insights; users should review what is captured for privacy. Offline storage path (SKILL.md:77) is a placeholder. No external-file dependencies.
